SELECT CAST(customer_id AS CHAR) AS customerId, name AS name, mobile AS mobile, CAST(profile_json AS CHAR) AS profileJson, DATE_FORMAT(last_active_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastActiveAt, status AS status FROM crm_customer WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
